title: Then he drives a stone hog thorn into the monster's insides, and the whole stomach sparks with lightning . . . (highlight)

segments.say: Then he drives a stone hog thorn into the monster's insides, and the whole stomach *sparks* with lightning.
The Black Flame Dragon hates it and the Secretive Plotter is *curious*. Dokja says they will talk terms after he clears the scenario.
He smears the mucus on his skin, so the stomach acid cannot *melt* him.
On the fourth day, the monster finally *dies*.
The hidden scenario ends with nine thousand coins, plus a thousand more for being the first to hunt a tier seven *monster*.
He lived on the monster's own fluid, sipped through the thorn, and it was a test of pure *willpower*.
Now the dokkaebi writes the contract. No sponsor, no other channel, and all profits *shared*.
But the contract forgot the ratio, so Dokja names it. Fifty-fifty? Nope, he takes all the *coins*.
The dokkaebi begs for seventy percent, Dokja says all or nothing, and the constellations start complaining about the *ads*.
So the dokkaebi gives in, and Dokja adds one more thing. Give me five thousand coins as a contract *fee*. Absolute menace.
Four days inside a monster, and Dokja walks out into fresh *air*, richer than before.
He even signed a stream contract with a dokkaebi. Not a bad *start*.
Then the dokkaebi tries to mess with his skills, and the Fourth Wall *blocks* even that.
A message says he has entered the second main scenario, and the air is full of *poison*.
The full story is on our channel.
